actions.command:
set -e
printf 'PWD=%s\n' "$PWD"
command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || true
command -v qemu-system-i386 || true
command -v telnet || true
command -v nc || true
ls -l /app || true
ls -l /app/alpine.iso || true
